verdict.rationale: HMRC's guidance pages on gov.uk publish instructions openly, including exact VAT thresholds and step-by-step registration and sign-up guidance with a Welsh version, which implies instructions can be read without signing in. However, no evidence shows the forms themselves are downloadable; the processes cited run through online services that need an account (business tax account, register-for-VAT service, MTD software). Missing for 10: evidence of downloadable forms (e.g., PDF/printable versions), explicit confirmation that instructions are available without an account, and independent corroboration.
